function.name: list_pieces
function.description: List the furniture and props you may place: id, size in metres, whether it blocks walking, tags.

tag.description: optional: only pieces with this tag or id part, e.g. medical, tavern, church, modern

function.name: new_room
function.description: Start a room. Returns the layout. x runs 0..w left to right, z runs 0..h top to bottom.

function.name: apply_ops
function.description: Change the room with a list of operations. ops: set_style{style}, furnish{preset}, clear_props, add_piece{t,x,z,rot}, move_piece{index,x,z,rot}, remove_piece{index}, add_door{x,z,w,axis}, add_window{x,z,w,axis}, add_wall{a:[x,z],b:[x,z]}, add_thing{x,z,label,text,act,res}, set_npc{x,z,label}, set_start{x,z}. Errors say exactly what to fix.

function.name: validate
function.description: Check a layout: overlaps, pieces outside the room, doors or examine spots that cannot be reached.

function.name: ascii
function.description: Draw the room as text so you can see where things are. Use it after changes.

function.name: render
function.description: Render the room to a picture (jpg) and a map pack the game can use. Returns the file paths.

function.name: add_piece_type
function.description: Define a NEW piece from primitives: {id,name,tags,size:[w,d],block,parts:[{shape:box|cyl|cone|sphere,size:[w,h,d] or r,h or r,pos:[x,y,z],rot:[deg,deg,deg],mat:wood|dark|iron|brass|sheet|stone|brick|crate|canvas|red|metalBlue|or '#rrggbb'}]}. y is up; the piece stands on y=0 and is centred on x,z.

function.name: map_case
function.description: Make maps for every scene of a written case (by id), automatically.

function.name: list_presets
function.description: List the room presets for furnish{preset}: id, name and style. Grouped by era in MAPS.md.

function.name: plan_case
function.description: Dry run: say which preset each scene of a written case would get, without drawing anything. Use before map_case.

function.name: import_model
function.description: Add a .glb/.gltf 3D model file as a piece. Give file path, id, name, tags and height in metres (the size is measured).

function.name: import_vtt
function.description: Convert a Dungeon Alchemist or Dungeondraft export (.dd2vtt/.uvtt) into a map pack.

function.name: install_map
function.description: Put a rendered map pack into a scene of a written case, with optional spots {label:[x,z]}, npcs {id:[x,z]} and start [x,z].

function.name: list_bust_parts
function.description: List every swappable part for a portrait bust (brows, eyes, mouths, noses, moustaches, beards, hair, hats, glasses, outfits) and the colour fields.

function.name: suggest_bust
function.description: Pick a period-right portrait spec from what is known about a person. Same name gives the same face. Returns {spec}; edit it, then render_portrait.

origin.description: place or people, e.g. Burgundy, Lagos, Rajasthan

mood.description: neutral, worried, stern, happy or shocked

function.name: render_portrait
function.description: Draw a portrait bust from a spec (see list_bust_parts) to a PNG in public/lab/portraits/. Returns the file paths.

function.name: inspect_character_model
function.description: Check a character .glb (a base body or a part) against the rules in CHARACTER-IMPORT.md: size in metres, anchor_* nodes, material names, morph targets, skeleton. Returns problems to fix in the 3D app.

function.name: import_character
function.description: Register a character model in the kit. kind base: a body with anchor_head, anchor_face and anchor_torso nodes (give height in metres). kind part: a hair, hat, glasses, brows, eyes, nose, mouth, moustache, beard, outfit or accessory piece (give slot, origin at its attach point; outfit may list base mesh names to hide). Returns warnings.

function.name: list_character_kit
function.description: List the registered character bases and parts (ids, slots, tags).

function.name: render_character
function.description: Assemble a character from the kit and draw a portrait (or full body) PNG. spec: { base, parts:{slot:partId}, colors:{skin,hair,cloth,cloth2,trim}, morphs:{name:0..1}, yaw }. view: portrait or full.
